name: The Sparklematic 5200!
summary: In Gnomeregan, soiled salvaged objects go into the Sparklematic 5200! for cleaning. Its cycles scour toxic grime away and package whatever remains in a gift box.

sections.title: Automated Cleansing
sections.body: You feed toxic and contaminated refuse into the Sparklematic 5200!, and its automated cycles scour away grime and caustic residue. Once loaded and paid, the machine rattles through its routine, then gives a cheerful ding and wraps whatever remains in a present tied with a bow.

sections.title: Treasure in the Sludge
sections.body: Radiation and industrial mire buried personal effects and scraps of technology when Gnomeregan fell to the troggs. Feed grime-encrusted objects into the machine, and gemstones, raw ores and other valuables swallowed when the city was vented may be reclaimed.

faq.answer: The Sparklematic 5200! cleans objects inside Gnomeregan. Supply a grime-encrusted object and a coin fee, and it scours away sludge, grime and radioactive muck before returning the contents in a small gift box.
The Sparklematic 5200! is inside the corridors of fallen Gnomeregan, near the Clean Zone where survivors and automated decontamination systems once operated.

faq.q: Why does the machine wrap items in a bow?
faq.answer: Gnomish whimsy gave the Sparklematic 5200! its bow-tied finish. After cleaning fallout and toxic grime from an item, it packages the restored object as a neatly tied present.

faq.q: Can Horde adventurers use the Sparklematic 5200?
faq.answer: Yes. The Sparklematic 5200! is automated and does not heed faction allegiance. Insert coins and soiled items, and it runs its cycle.

faq.q: Can I use the Sparklematic multiple times?
faq.answer: Yes. After its first operation, the Sparklematic 5200! can be used for repeat cleaning. Bring grime-encrusted items found throughout the dungeon to process them again.
After the first cleaning, you can use the repeatable cycle called More Sparklematic Action to clean any additional grime-encrusted finds you carry.

angles.text: As a gnome, the Sparklematic recalls home before the fall. Even an industrial scrub unit chimed cheerfully and wrapped its finished work like a birthday present.
As an engineer, you can study how the Sparklematic cleans particles automatically and packages items quickly, even amid heavy radiation.
